summary: Secure, reproducible development environments for developers and AI agents, integrating with IDEs like VSCode and JetBrains, enabling remote coding with full local tooling support.
usecases: Remote development with consistent environments across teams.
AI agent development and execution in isolated, secure sandboxes.
On-demand dev environment spin-up for CI/CD or collaborative coding.
ideas: Integrate with cloud providers for ephemeral dev environments per PR.
Support for multi-user collaborative editing within coder environments.
